messages.subject: System.file problems
parts:
Hi Jürgen
I have been to whole morning trying to understand why this (the example in the vignette) works:

>wd_images_raw <- system.file("pictures/raw_images/", package = "camtrapR")

and this does not work:

>wd_images_raw <- system.file("/home/bernat/temp/camtrapR/raw_images/", package = "camtrapR")

When I add "mustwork=TRUE" I get this message

Error in system.file("/home/bernat/temp/camtrapR/raw_images/", package = "camtrapR",  :
  no file found

In my folder I have exactly the same structure as in the vignette (StationA with some pictures and Station B with some more).

Any idea? Thanks in advance
Bernat

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: System.file problems
parts:
Hi Bernat,
system.file is only needed in the function examples to find the camtrapR package directory where the sample images are stored. In the example above, it finds the subdirectory "pictures/raw_images/" in the camtrapR package directory. Have a look at wd_images_raw. For me it is:
system.file("pictures/raw_images/", package = "camtrapR")

[1] "C:/Users/niedballa/Documents/R/win-library/3.3/camtrapR/pictures/raw_images"



When you work on your own data, you don't need system.file. Simply specify the directory as a function argument, e.g. (made-up example):

recordTable(inDir = "C:/myStudy/CameraTrapImages/Identified",
                   ...)     # all the other arguments need to be set properly

Jürgen
